description: Tucked deep inside the heights of Guanapo, this tall, narrow waterfall empties into a small pool that allows for swimming. The hike to the waterfall is moderately challenging and follows a bench trail through old agricultural estates. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
